meta.description: Convert Millimeter (mm) to Nautical Mile (nmi) instantly. 1 mm = 5.399568e-7 nmi. Free, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Convert millimeters (mm) to nautical miles (nmi) instantly. Both measure length, so the relationship is strictly linear: each millimeter equals 5.399568e-7 nautical miles. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One millimeter is equal to **5.399568e-7 nautical miles**. To go the other way, one nautical mile equals **1852000 millimeters**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> nautical miles = millimeters × 5.399568e-7

Worked example — converting 10 millimeters:

10 × 5.399568e-7 = **5.399568e-6 nmi**.

To invert, divide by 5.399568e-7 (or multiply by 1852000).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 mm ≈ 5.399568e-7 nmi. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Millimeter and Nautical Mile both measure length; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many nautical miles are in 1 millimeter?
**A:** 5.399568e-7 nautical miles.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert mm to nmi?
**A:** nautical miles = millimeters × 5.399568e-7.

**Q:** How do I convert nmi back to mm?
**A:** Multiply by 1852000 (or divide by 5.399568e-7).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this mm to nmi converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
